# Hymeg Corporation

> Precision, high-value, and high-voltage thick film resistors and resistor networks. Parent company: Electro Technik Industries, Inc.

Hymeg engineers specialize in thick film resistors with over 40 years of experience. Products cover roughly 1.0–30.0 KVDC and average power ratings up to 6 watts, for medical, defense, laser, instrumentation, and commercial applications. Custom resistors and fast lead times are available.

## Contact

- Phone: (800) 322-1953
- Email: HYMEG@ELECTROTECHNIK.COM
- Address: P.O. Box 18802, Clearwater, FL 33762, USA
- Cage Code: 9T572

## Products

- [Thick Film High-Voltage Resistors (HV series)](https://www.hymeg.com/thick-film-resistor-high-voltage.html): 1–6 W; higher voltages and power densities; values to 50,000 Meg Ohms
- [Precision Thick Film Resistors (HA series)](https://www.hymeg.com/precision-thick-film-resistor-high-voltage.html): 0.5–5 W; tighter tolerances and lower TCR
- [Precision Plate Resistors & Dividers (FV / DVN)](https://www.hymeg.com/precision-plate-resistor-high-voltage.html): 1–6 W; high voltage stability; up to ~30 KVDC
- [High Value Non-Inductive Thick Film (FA series)](https://www.hymeg.com/high-value-non-inductive-thick-film-resistor-high-voltage.html): 0.5–5 W; non-inductive; values up to 4 Tera Ohms

PDF datasheets for individual SKUs are under https://www.hymeg.com/assets/ (e.g. HV60.pdf, HA100.pdf, FV15.pdf, FA200.pdf).
